decisions.reason: The copper-coated glass substrates under the ACT banner are a publicly announced flagship of the firm's move toward higher-value 3D-integration and high-frequency applications, rest on substantial invested development in core glass capabilities, and complement the new through-glass via structuring, so management will persist and attribute any slow uptake to market ramp-up.

VLIS was launched only in 2024 with a dedicated page as a next-generation semiconductor solution central to the firm's announced investment in newer processing technologies, so the heavy visible commitment and its early stage make withdrawal within a year very unlikely.
